channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Erdoğan: Clear message sent over downed Iran missile
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan warned on March 4 that Türkiye would not tolerate a repeat of a missile incident involving Iran, saying Ankara has issued clear warnings and is taking necessary measures to safeguard its borders and airspace.

item.title: 65.5 billion lira investment planned to support rural development
item.description: The Agriculture and Forestry Ministry plans to invest approximately 65.5 billion Turkish Liras ($1.49 billion) over the next three years to support activities under the Rural Development Program.

item.title: Türkiye invests in foreign legion to deliver LA Olympics gold
item.description: Türkiye is offering long-term financial support to recruit Jamaican and Kenyan track and field stars with the aim of winning a host of gold medals at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

item.title: Temporary sliding scale system introduced for fuel prices
item.description: Türkiye has temporarily introduced a sliding scale (eşel mobil) system to mitigate the impact of rising fuel prices caused by geopolitical developments.

item.title: Türkiye welcomes EU inclusion in 'Made in EU' draft
item.description: The legal confirmation of Türkiye's inclusion in the "Made in EU" policy marks a significant step for trade relations, Trade Minister Ömer Bolat has stated.

item.title: Türkiye warns against ‘fait accompli’ on status of Aegean islands
item.description: Türkiye on March 5 warned against attempts to undermine the demilitarized status of Aegean islands, saying it would not allow any “fait accompli” that contradicts international agreements governing the islands.

item.title: Azerbaijan says Iran drone attack 'will not go unanswered'
item.description: Azerbaijan said it was preparing to retaliate after two people were wounded on Thursday in Iranian drone hits on an airport and near a school.

item.title: Residents flee as Mideast war spirals with fresh strikes
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of residents were rushing to flee the Iranian capital and Lebanon’s south as the war in the Middle East enters its sixth day, with Iran, Israel and the United States exchanging aerial strikes.

item.title: Türkiye says reserves right to respond after missile interception, Iran denies role
item.description: Defense authorities said on March 5 that Türkiye reserves the right to respond to hostile actions after a ballistic missile detected heading toward its airspace from Iran was intercepted by NATO air and missile defense systems, while Iran denied firing any missile toward Turkish territory.

item.title: Turkish, Azerbaijani presidents discuss drone attack on Nakhchivan
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and his Azerbaijani counterpart Ilham Aliyev on Thursday discussed a drone strike on Azerbaijan's autonomous Nakhchivan exclave, which injured four people.
